scope: Frozen claim-to-evidence and submission-boundary records only. No manuscript, source tree, experiment, acceptance oracle, portal, author record, or deployment state was changed.

prior_evidence_boundary.classification: Repository-reported preliminary arithmetic and source/capability inventory only; no live experiment was inferred.

source_versions.deadline_source: The review records a prior CFP check with tentative dates. This task did not access, authenticate to, or act on a submission portal.

criteria.criterion: Every main-text claim and Table 17/18 row has an evidence obligation or an explicit removal/narrowing decision.
criteria.explanation: The matrix covers 32 abstract/main-text claim units (including Tables 1--5) and separately assigns owners and obligations to all four Table 17 rows and six Table 18 rows. Each has a controlled decision vocabulary and a publication rule; native and world/procedure rows have explicit narrowing closures.

criteria.criterion: Required core tasks are separated from optional implementation campaigns; unavailable optional backends have a truthful closure path.
criteria.explanation: Scope freezes a source-linked context/routing/translation/reuse/publication/evaluation core, while native proof, learned/world/procedure, semantic-editing/refactoring, and federation work have explicit qualified-or-future-work closures. The closure forbids mock proof records and does not make unavailable optional backends block the core.

criteria.criterion: The paper goal cannot pass by emptying a queue or changing the oracle/acceptance standard.
criteria.explanation: Both the matrix and scope require a fixed, independent oracle; matched A--D controls; current mandatory evidence; full terminal denominators; and cold scoring for reuse. They explicitly reject queue exhaustion, local no-call/hook evidence, stored artifacts, candidate booleans, and protocol changes made to make an arm pass as success.

criteria.criterion: No author identity, consent, model-use facts, or positive results are inferred.
criteria.explanation: The scope admits only inspected provenance, explicitly limited preliminary arithmetic, or conditional design at this stage. It reserves author-dependent facts for author-confirmable NS-024/025 records and directs all final positive findings to independently scored frozen-run evidence. The deadline plan creates no portal or submission side effect.
